question: The Working Group under the chairmanship of ________ in the year ________ proposed a new intermediate monetary aggregate to be referred to as NM2.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dr. YV Reddy; 1998**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Working Group under the chairmanship of Dr. YV Reddy was constituted in 1998.
 
• The group proposed a new intermediate monetary aggregate to be referred to as NM2.
 
• Dr. YV Reddy was a prominent Indian economist and served as the 21st Governor of the Reserve Bank of India.
 
• The proposal for NM2 was part of an effort to refine and improve the country's monetary policy framework.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Monetary Aggregates:**

 
 
• Monetary aggregates are broad categories measuring the total value of the money supply within an economy. They include various forms of money such as cash, demand deposits, and near money.
 
• They are used by central banks to assess the amount of money circulating within an economy, helping in formulating monetary policy.
 
• Common monetary aggregates include M1, M2, M3, and M4, which represent different levels of liquidity.
 
 
 
• **Intermediate Monetary Aggregate NM2:**
 
 
• NM2 is an intermediate monetary aggregate proposed to provide a better understanding and control over the monetary supply.
 
• It typically includes cash, demand deposits, and other near money instruments which are less liquid than those in M1 but more liquid than those in M3.
 
 
 
• **Dr. YV Reddy:**
 
 
• Yaga Venugopal Reddy served as the 21st Governor of the Reserve Bank of India from 2003 to 2008.
 
• He played a crucial role in shaping India's monetary policy and was known for his efforts to maintain financial stability.
 
• He was also involved in various international financial institutions and contributed significantly to economic policy discussions.
